page_title: LIL 0-1 LYO | Lille v Lyon 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+6' That was close by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
90+6' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

90+4' Hamza Igamane (Lille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
90+3' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+3' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lille force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+2' Substitution. Tiago Santos will be replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
90+1' Substitution. Malick Fofana walks off the pitch and Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' Tiago Santos (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
90' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the top left corner, but Dominik Greif is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
87' Hamza Igamane (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
87' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
86' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
83' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
80' Rough tackle by Pavel Sulc (Lyon). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Here is a change. Ayyoub Bouaddi is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Hamza Igamane (Lille).
78' Calvin Verdonk (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mathieu Vernice saw the whole situation.
76' Yellow card. Afonso Moreira (Lyon) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
75' Khalis Merah comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pavel Sulc (Lyon).
75' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Adam Karabec is replaced by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ngalayel Mukau leaves the pitch and Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) comes on.
74' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Felix Correia and he is replaced by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
73' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Malick Fofana (Lyon) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
72' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner but it's cleared.
72' Bruno Genesio is stunned as referee Mathieu Vernice shows him a RED CARD.
69' Aissa Mandi (Lille) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
69' Malick Fofana (Lyon) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
68' The ball rebounds to Felix Correia (Lille) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.

66' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
64' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
63' Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul after Khalis Merah (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
62' Tiago Santos (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Olivier Giroud (Lille) offside.
61' Malick Fofana (Lyon) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
60' Olivier Giroud (Lille) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
59' Olivier Giroud (Lille) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mathieu Vernice who sees an offensive foul.
56' Felix Correia (Lille) sends a chip pass into the box, but Dominik Greif is quickest to intercept the ball.
55' Lyon hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' The corner by Adam Karabec (Lyon) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
50' Good clearance! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
48' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle. Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) commits a foul after dangerous play.
47' PENALTY APPEAL after Olivier Giroud (Lille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
46' What was Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Olivier Giroud (Lille) commits a foul and Mathieu Vernice immediately signals a free kick.
45+4' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
45+2' Tiago Santos (Lille) touches the ball with his hand. It's a free kick to Lyon, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Mathieu Vernice and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
41' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

40' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
39' The game is interrupted as Adam Karabec (Lyon) is flagged offside.
38' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
38' The linesman signals that Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
36' Felix Correia (Lille) makes a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) gathers a rebound, beats his marker and goes for goal from distance, but one of his own teammates inadvertently blocks the effort.
34' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game. One of the players from Lyon won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
33' Felix Correia (Lille) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
31' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. The linesman makes the right call and Lille will have a corner.
31' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to Lille.
30' Poor challenge! Malick Fofana (Lyon) is penalised for tripping and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle.
27' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
27' Tiago Santos (Lille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
26' Calvin Verdonk (Lille) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Olivier Giroud in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball.
25' Felix Correia (Lille) is penalised for a foul. Mathieu Vernice had a clear view and blows his whistle.
23' Adam Karabec (Lyon) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Khalis Merah.
22' Tiago Santos (Lille) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
21' It looks like Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) saw red with that tackle. Mathieu Vernice won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
21' Olivier Giroud (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
21' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon).
19' The players claim that Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
19' The referee awards a corner and Calvin Verdonk (Lille) goes over to take it.

19' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Good work from Lille as they win a corner.
18' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle as Olivier Giroud (Lille) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

18' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Dominik Greif pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the middle of the target.
16' Malick Fofana (Lyon) makes a good run to meet a precise cross just outside the box. He latches on to it and strikes the ball, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
15' Malick Fofana (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Adam Karabec collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
15' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Nicolas Tagliafico picks out Tyler Morton (Lyon) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the left side of the goal with a header from close range. 0:1.
12' Calvin Verdonk (Lille) makes a strong challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
11' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and it's Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

11' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Dominik Greif shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
10' Dominik Greif (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
8' Dominik Greif (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' What a great touch by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.

5' Felix Correia (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
4' Adam Karabec (Lyon) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice was nominated as the referee for this game.
